classes.saturating_transition: a ledger update whose arithmetic is guarded so it cannot wrap; the guard's other arm clamps the ledger (0 or SIZE_MAX) and logs, so the ledger then diverges from the sum it tracks
classes.strict_bound: the limit test is evaluated before the charge, in arithmetic that cannot wrap, and admission implies ledger + charge <= limit
classes.batch_overshoot: the limit test is evaluated once before a batch of charges; the batch can pass the limit by at most the batch's own size
classes.advisory: the limit is tested after the charge, or a caller can bypass it; nothing in the test bounds the overshoot
classes.snapshot: the value is recomputed from the physical set (not a running ledger), so it has no transition to check
